<thought>We need to search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that matches the flavanone product. The criteria are: break aromatic hydroxyls and ketones, form ether oxygens, form C‑C and C‑O bonds, and break a C‑O bond. Bond types must be given as atomic numbers: C‑C = "6-6", C‑O = "6-8". We'll use the SMILES for a typical flavanone (chalcone cyclized) and the functional group names from the available list.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(Cc1ccc(O)cc1)C2CC(O)C3=CC=CC=C3O2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
